from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single Basic EPS value extracted from one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting this figure")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this figure (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    eps_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of share metric reported (e.g., 'Basic', 'Diluted')")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label used in the statement (e.g., 'Basic Net Loss Per Common Share')")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The value of the EPS; losses should be represented as negative numbers")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., 'USD', 'dollars')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the value for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    basic_eps_records: list[EPSRecord]
